unit: Aqua MODIS daytime vegetation-fire detections per H3 res-5 cell per month
sampling: at most 300 held-out cell-months per country, uniform without replacement, numpy default_rng([20261114, crc32(country)]); all cell-months when fewer
baseline_definition: prediction = ratio * Suomi-NPP detections in the cell-month, ratio = Aqua / Suomi-NPP detections in the country over 2012-2018 only
metric_definitions: same cell-month table and formulas as fit_harmonization.metrics (r2 = 1 - SS_res/SS_tot, bias_pct = 100*(sum pred - sum obs)/sum obs, rmse); mae = mean |obs - pred|
